Ed Sheeran's "Galway Girl" reached #53 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Galway Girl" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran.

The song peaked at #53 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 5 weeks on the chart.

Galway Girl was released in 2017.
